spans.s: + अपिधान शिला- + अपिधान, adj., f. ना, covered by stones,
+ उच्चय शिला- + उच्चय, m. a mountain,
+ उञ्छ शिल- + उञ्छ, m. gleaning ears and grains,
+ जतु शिला- + जतु, n. 1. bitumen. 2. red chalk.
+ तल शिला- + तल, n. the surface of a stone.
+ धातु शिला- + धातु, m. 1. chalk. 2. red chalk.
+ निधि शील-ज्ञान- + निधि, m. a virtuous and learned person.
+ पट्ट शिला- + पट्ट, m. 1. a rocky seat,
. a flat stone for grinding condiments.
+ पट्टक शिला- + पट्टक, m. a rocky seat,
+ पुत्र शिला- + पुत्र, m. a muller or roller for grinding condiments on a flat stone.
+ फलक शिला- + फलक, n. a layer or table of stone.
+ मुख शिली- + मुख, m. 1. a bee, Śiś. 9, 41. 2. an arrow, ib.;
+ वृत्ति शील- + वृत्ति, f. virtue, Pañc. ii. d. 154.
+ शाला शिल्प- + शाला, n., and f. ला, a workshop.
† शिल् शिल्, सिल् सिल्, i. 6, Par. To glean (cf. the next).
शील् (probably a denomin. derived from the next), i. 1,

. † To meditate.
 2. To adore, to worship.
 --Caus., and i. 10,

. † To repeat.
 7. † To surpass.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शीलित, Skilled, conversant.

शिल,
 A. n. Gleaning ears of corn,

; 10, 112.
 B. i. e. probably शो + ल,
 I. f. ला.
 1. A stone, Pañc. 100, 18; a rock, Vikr. d. 49.
 2. A flat stone on which condiments are ground.
 3. Arsenic.
 II. f. ला and ली.
 1. A stone or beam placed across a post or pillar.
 2. The timber of a door frame.
 III. f. ली.
 1. A dart, an arrow,

शील, i. e.
 A. शिष् + ल (m. and) n.
 1. Nature, quality.

. Disposition, inclination, character, Pañc. i. d. 282; a good character, Pañc. v. d. 2.
 3. Moral practice,

. Beauty.
 B. शी + ल, m. A large snake.
 --Comp.

शिलाटक, m.
 1. A room on the top of a house.
 2. A hole.
and ली शिली̆ (cf. शिली, under शिल), f. The lower timber of a door.

शिलीन्ध्र,
 I. m.
 1. A sort of tree.
 2. A kind of fish.
 II. f. री.
 1. Clay, earth.
 2. A small earthworm (cf. शिली, under शिल).
 3. A sort of bird.
 III. n.
 1. Hail (cf. शिला).
 2. A mushroom,
. The flower of the plantain tree.
शिलीपद (a dialect. form of श्लीपद, q. cf.), m. A morbid enlargement of the leg,

शिल्प, n.
 1. Proficiency in any manual or mechanical art, or profession; art, Pañc. i. d. 4, 446; Bhāg.

. A sort of spoon used at sacrifices to throw the butter into the fire.
 --Comp.

शिल्पिक, i. e. शिल्प + इक,
 I. adj. Manual, mechanic.
 II. n.
 1.
. (and शिस्पक शिल्प + क), A sort of drama.

शिल्पिन्, i. e. शिल्प + इन्,
 I. adj. Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art.
 II. m., f. नी, and n. An artificer, a mechanic, Pañc. 10, 6; Johns.

शील + तस्, adv.
 1. By natural disposition, Pañc. i. d. 288.
 2. Concerning the character, Daśak. in
-शील + ता, f. in त्याग-, Generosity, Hit. i. d. 104, M.M. शालीन-, f. Bashfulness, Utt.
शील + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Of a good disposition,
